method: Node assertions against fictional UI-free study logic; no browser, person, transport or security isolation
checks: Content has no commit, review or transport port
Choosing locally queues nothing and leaves the conversation intact
Reject unsupported times, party sizes and injected recipient/HTML fields
Review binds exact text, recipient and identity; returned objects cannot rewrite it
Cancel shares nothing and retains choices and latest draft
Fold restores reading and focus context and invalidates review
Double submission and re-review of the same request cannot duplicate the queue
Simulated failure retains selection; retry requires a fresh review and queues once
Instances isolate requests; caller changes do not rewrite the bound source
